productArea.name: Wiki
productArea.scope: Create, edit, rename, and delete wiki pages, filter page names, and inspect Markdown rendering, previews, page navigation, revision history, comparisons, and diff downloads. Repository code, issue discussions, and enabling the Wiki unit in settings are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Wiki to create or open a page and use its page filter, editor, preview, and revision controls. Enable Wiki in a disposable repository only as a prerequisite if needed.
